meta.name: sheets-cli
meta.description: Read, write, and update Google Sheets data via CLI. Use when the user asks to read spreadsheet data, update cells, append rows, or work with Google Sheets. Triggers on mentions of spreadsheets, sheets, Google Sheets, tabular data in the cloud, or specific sheet names like "Projects" or "Tasks".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过命令行读写 Google Sheets 表格数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常用命令行处理 Google Sheets 数据
copy.tagline_en: Read and update Google Sheets data from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with Google Sheets data via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 sheets-cli 命令读取、修改 Google Sheets:按名称找表格、读取表格数据、追加行、按关键列或行号更新单元格,并支持批量和试运行预览。
howto.when: 当你说到“表格”“Google Sheets”等词,或提到具体表名(如“Projects”),或要求读取、更新、追加表格数据时触发。

say.text: 用 sheets-cli 找到名为“项目”的表格
say.note: 按名字搜索,返回 ID、名称和链接。

say.text: 读取“任务”工作表前 100 行数据
say.note: 返回表头和带行号的数据。

say.text: 把“任务”中 TASK-42 的状态改为“完成”,先试运行
say.note: 先预览更新,确认后再执行。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the sheets-cli command to read and modify Google Sheets: find a spreadsheet by name, list tabs, read table or range data, append rows, update cells by key column or row index, and run batch operations. Output is JSON and dry-run is supported.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions spreadsheets, sheets, Google Sheets, cloud tabular data, or specific sheet names, or asks to read spreadsheet data, update cells, or append rows.

say_en.text: Use sheets-cli to find the spreadsheet named "Projects"
say_en.note: Runs sheets find by name; returns ID, name, and URL.

say_en.text: Read the first 100 rows from the "Tasks" sheet
say_en.note: Runs read table; returns headers and rows with row numbers.

say_en.text: Update TASK-42 status to Complete in Tasks, dry-run first
say_en.note: Previews the key-based update before applying.
